SmolderW.tooltip:
Smolder lets out an adorable flaming sneeze, dealing @InitialDamage@ physical damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing @ExplosionDamage@ physical + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_WDamageIncrease@ magic damage.
Each consecutive explosion does @ExplosionDamageMultihitPenalty*100@% damage.
Smolder can only gain one Dragon Practice stack per champion hit.

SmolderQ.name: Super Scorcher Breath
SmolderQ.tooltip:
Smolder belches flame, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:Passive_QDamageIncrease@ magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds @ManaRestore@ Mana, once per cast.

Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:
  • @StackTier1@ Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.
  • @StackTier2@ Stacks: Sends @Tier2_NumberOfBlowback@ explosions beyond the target that deal @Tier2_BlowbackPercentageDamage@% of this Ability's damage.
  • @StackTier3@ Stacks: Burns the target, dealing @Tier3_Burn@ max Health true damage over @Tier3_DotLength@ seconds. Enemy champions that drop below @Tier3_ExecuteThreshold@ total health while burning are killed instantly.
    Super Scorcher Breath is considered a basic Attack, applies On-Hit effects, and applies Life Steal at @LifestealMod*100@% effectiveness.
    Damage is increased by %i:scaleCrit% Critical Strike Chance and %i:scaleCritMult% Critical Strike Damage at @CritRatio*100@% effectiveness.
    This Ability can only damage each target one time per cast.

Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage. Enemies in the center take @TooltipOnly_TotalSweetspotDamage@ physical damage instead and are Slowed by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

SmolderE.name: Flap, Flap, Flap
SmolderE.tooltip:
Smolder takes flight, gaining @MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed and ignoring terrain for @Duration@ seconds.

While flying, Smolder bombards the lowest Health enemy @TotalNumberOfAttacks@ (rounded down) times for @DamagePerHit@ physical damage + @spell.SmolderP:EBonusDamage@ magic damage per hit.
This Ability prioritizes champions.
While flying, Smolder gains expanded vision.

SmolderP.name: Dragon Practice
SmolderP.tooltip:
Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic Abilities.
  • Super Scorcher Breath: Deal an additional @Passive_QDamageIncrease@ magic damage and gain new effects at @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier1@, @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier2@, and @spell.SmolderQ:StackTier3@ stacks.
  • Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional @Passive_WDamageIncrease@ magic damage.
  • Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional @EBonusDamage@ magic damage and gain an extra bolt every @EStacksPerAttackTooltip@ stacks.

    Smolder has acquired Dragon Practice: @f1.0@.
